verdict.rationale: Snowflake documents natural-language interaction through Cortex Analyst, where business users ask questions in natural language and get answers without SQL. Cortex Code is described as an AI coding agent for data engineering workflows, and the marketing site says "Ask anything with Snowflake CoWork." The evidence covers natural-language querying and coding help, but not using natural language to operate or administer the product broadly (managing warehouses, roles, pipelines). missing for 10: documented natural-language control of platform operations and administration, detail on Cortex Code/CoWork capabilities beyond one-line mentions, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: With Cortex Analyst, business users can ask questions in natural language and receive direct answers without writing SQL.
Cortex Code — AI-driven coding agent integrated into Snowflake for data engineering workflows.
